name: starfab fab hall
unofficialDisclaimer: Unofficial fan or learning project, not affiliated with SpaceX.

hall.label: Fab hall
hall.blurb: A fictional wafer line: six process areas in series in two identical bays, with many tools per area.

demandInfo.statement: sized against an announced initial target of 100,000 wafer starts a month for a planned chip plant, times 12

annualDemandKits.title: Wikipedia: Terafab (announced initial target of 100,000 wafer starts a month)
annualDemandKits.excerpt: An announced target, not a measured output. Used only to size a fictional hall.

annualDemandKitsUse.note: 1,200,000 wafers a year treated as demand on this fictional hall, spread evenly over the year.

calendarDays.note: Demand is spread evenly over 365 days.

hoursPerDay.note: Coverage is modeled as 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

parallelLines.note: 2 identical bays in parallel. Real fab organisation is unknown.

meanDowntimeEventSeconds.note: Mean downtime event of 1,800 seconds, exact budget per tool.

bufferCapacity.note: Room for 5 wafers between areas, standing in for stockers and transport.

downtimeReasons.note: Reasons cycle at 4, 3, 2, 1 per 10 events. Not plant data.

flattenedRoute.note: One unit is one wafer and each station visit stands for all of its visits to that area.

endOfShiftWip.note: Incomplete units at the end of the shift are WIP.

starts.note: New wafers start at the first area whenever a tool is free.

name.note: Six textbook process areas in series. Not a real route or layout.

cycleTimeSeconds.note: Summed cycle time per wafer per tool. Invented round number, not measured.

parallelUnits.note: Tools per area per bay. Real tool counts are unknown.

operators.note: One operator per area. Real staffing is unknown.

firstPassYield.note: Yield 0.99 per area, per wafer, no rework. Real yields are unknown.

availability.note: Availability 0.90. Real tool availability is unknown.

performance.note: Pace of 0.95 versus the summed cycle. Real pace is unknown.
